# Resource (rootly_status_page_component_group)



## Example Usage

```shell
resource "rootly_status_page_component_group" "infrastructure" {
  status_page_id       = rootly_status_page.public.id
  name                 = "Infrastructure"
  description          = "Core infrastructure services"
  collapsed_by_default = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the component group
- `status_page_id` (String)

### Optional

- `collapsed_by_default` (Boolean) Whether the group renders collapsed on the public page. Value must be one of true or false
- `description` (String) Description of the component group
- `position` (Number) Position of the group on the status page's top-level list

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

rootly_status_page_component_group can be imported using the [`import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import).

```sh
terraform import rootly_status_page_component_group.primary a816421c-6ceb-481a-87c4-585e47451f24
```

Or using an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import).

```terraform
import {
  to = rootly_status_page_component_group.primary
  id = "a816421c-6ceb-481a-87c4-585e47451f24"
}
```

Locate the resource id in the web app, or retrieve it by listing resources through the API if it's not visible in the web app.

HCL can be generated from the import block using the `-generate-config-out` flag.

```sh

```
